examples.name: Square-free?
examples.script: ? ~ E i,n. n>=1 & (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[i+n+t])

examples.name: A square, with witness
examples.script: witness n>=1 & (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[i+n+t])
examples.note: shortest (i,n) whose base-k word the automaton accepts

examples.name: Critical exponent probe 7/3
examples.note: run the ladder 2/1 … 5/1 to bracket the critical exponent

examples.name: Critical exponent ladder
examples.note: the exponent is the last TRUE

examples.name: Periods that admit a square
examples.script: dfa n>=1 & (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[i+n+t])
examples.note: the set of n such that some ww of period n occurs

examples.name: Palindromic factors?
examples.script: ? E i,n. n>=3 & (A t,u. t+u+1 = n => T[i+t] = T[i+u])

examples.name: Arbitrarily long palindromes?
examples.script: ? A n. E i,m. m >= n & (A t,u. t+u+1 = m => T[i+t] = T[i+u])

examples.name: Palindrome of length 9 — positions
examples.script: enum 120 (A t,u. t+u+1 = 9 => T[i+t] = T[i+u])
examples.note: paints every position starting a length-9 palindrome onto the tape

examples.name: Unbordered factor of every length?
examples.script: ? A n. n>=1 => E i. ~(E b,j. b >= 1 & b < n & j + b = i + n & (A t. t < b => T[i+t] = T[j+t]))

examples.name: Lengths admitting an unbordered factor
examples.script: dfa E i. ~(E b,j. b >= 1 & b < n & j + b = i + n & (A t. t < b => T[i+t] = T[j+t]))

examples.name: Right-special factors
examples.script:
let RS(i,n) E j. (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[j+t]) & T[i+n] != T[j+n]
enum 80 $RS(i,4)
examples.note: positions whose length-4 factor extends two ways

examples.name: Is every length right-special?
examples.script:
let RS(i,n) E j. (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[j+t]) & T[i+n] != T[j+n]
? A n. E i. $RS(i,n)

examples.name: FE — equality of factors
examples.script:
let FE(i,j,l) A t. t < l => T[i+t] = T[j+t]
mem
export FE
examples.note: the direct construction; the one Khodier's Open Problem 1 is about

examples.name: FE by guess-and-verify (learnfe)
examples.script:
learnfe FE
mem
export FE
examples.note: active learning against an LCP oracle, checked against the recurrence

examples.name: Recurrence of a long factor
examples.script:
learnfe G
witness i < j & $G(i,j,60)
finite E j. j > i & $G(i,j,200)
examples.note: where the length-60 factor at 0 recurs, and whether every factor recurs

examples.name: Peltomäki extRS2 stack
examples.script:
let factorEq(i,n,m) A t. t < i => T[n+t] = T[m+t]
let isRS(i,n) E p,q. $factorEq(i,n,p) & $factorEq(i,n,q) & T[p+i] != T[q+i]
let extRS2(i,j,n) i<j & (E m1,m2. $isRS(j,m1) & $isRS(j,m2) & $factorEq(i,m1,m2) & $factorEq(i,n,m1) & T[m1+i] != T[m2+i])
? E i,j,n. $extRS2(i,j,n)
examples.note: the published Walnut OOM case; runs here in milliseconds

examples.name: Every factor occurs infinitely often?
examples.script: ? A i,n,N. E j. j >= N & (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = T[j+t])

examples.name: Closed under reversal?
examples.script: ? A i,n. E j. (A t,u. t+u+1 = n => T[i+t] = T[j+u])

examples.name: Positions where T = 1
examples.script: enum 200 T[i] = 1

examples.name: Lengths of runs of 0
examples.script: dfa E i. (A t. t < n => T[i+t] = 0)

examples.name: Arbitrarily long APs of step 3 that are constant 0
examples.script: ? A n. E i. (A t. t < n => T[i+3*t] = 0)
